title_en: A young bride sits under a willow
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: The last line 'назад не греби' is my reading ('will not come back', literally 'not rake/row back'). 'ка ја што' = 'as I do' (dialect). Origin unclear, looks traditional.

lines.en: A young bride sits under a willow,

lines.cyr: плачи и жали за прво либе,
lines.lat: plači i žali za prvo libe,
lines.en: she weeps and mourns for her first love,

lines.cyr: плачи и жали за прво либе
lines.lat: plači i žali za prvo libe
lines.en: she weeps and mourns for her first love
and speaks sadly to the willow.
- Oh willow, thick and green willow,
why have you bent your branches down,
why have you bent your branches down,

lines.cyr: навела си и кај мојта глава.
lines.lat: navela si i kaj mojta glava.
lines.en: you bent them down even by my head.

lines.cyr: Дали си жалиш за твојте лисја,
lines.lat: Dali si žališ za tvojte lisja,
lines.en: Do you grieve for your leaves

lines.cyr: ка ја што жалам за прво либе?
lines.lat: ka ja što žalam za prvo libe?
lines.en: as I grieve for my first love?

lines.cyr: Пролет ќе дојде пак ќе развиеш,
lines.lat: Prolet ḱe dojde pak ḱe razvieš,
lines.en: In spring you will bloom again,

lines.cyr: а мојто либе назад не греби.
lines.lat: a mojto libe nazad ne grebi.
lines.en: but my love will not come back.
